# Townsfolk: Friends

A Minecraft mod that tracks all villagers you have met in a personal journal.

## Features

- **Villager Journal** - Press **J** to open your journal of met villagers
- **Automatic Tracking** - Villagers are added when you get within 5 blocks
- **Head Previews** - Each entry shows the villager head that follows your cursor
- **Villager Info** - See name, profession, and biome where you met them
- **Persistent Data** - Your journal saves across sessions

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| J | Open/Close Villager Journal |
| E | Close Journal |
| Escape | Close Journal |
| Scroll | Navigate list |

## Part of the Townsfolk Series

This mod is part of the Townsfolk mod series:
- **Townsfolk: Names** - Auto-names villagers with biome-aware names
- **Townsfolk: Friends** - Track villagers you have met (this mod)
- **Townsfolk: Signs** - Declare rooms with wall signs
- **Townsfolk: Tenants** - Villagers rent hotel rooms
